base.text:
Aura: Your Spells have Cloaked. Spells you set face-down resolve when set and when revealed.
Cry: Draw {draw}.

radiant.text:
Aura: Your Spells have Cloaked. Spells you set face-down resolve when set and when revealed. Spells you reveal have Echo +{echo}.
Cry: Draw {draw}.

base.text:
When played face down: Look at your opponent's hand and choose a card secretly.
Reveals if your opponent plays the chosen card before any of the other cards you saw. Take control of that card instead. Otherwise, Tribute this Trap.

radiant.text:
When played face down: Look at your opponent's hand and choose a card secretly.
Reveals if your opponent plays the chosen card. Take control of that card instead.
